plugin.name: Cron Heartbeat
plugin.author: Envesko
plugin.description: Track whether your scheduled cron jobs actually run. Drop one cronGuard() call at the top of any cron file to enforce an IP allowlist and record a heartbeat. The dashboard widget and config page show every job's last run, run count, and flags any job that has gone stale. Complements the built-in Cron Manager, which schedules jobs but does not verify they ran.
